receipts.name: schema
receipts.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_catalog='frozen' AND table_name IN ('facts','sources','edges','inventory') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

rows.data_type: STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, renamed_from STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, file STRUCT(path VARCHAR, "encoding" VARCHAR, bytes VARCHAR), symbol STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, "commit" VARCHAR)))

STRUCT(nodes STRUCT(node_id UBIGINT, stable_key VARCHAR, "label" VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR, file_id UBIGINT, source_span_id UBIGINT, first_seen_run_id UBIGINT)[], edges STRUCT(edge_id UBIGINT, source_node_id UBIGINT, target_node_id UBIGINT, relation VARCHAR, target_label VARCHAR, import_path VARCHAR, receiver_text VARCHAR, scope_text VARCHAR, confidence VARCHAR, confidence_score FLOAT, edge_kind VARCHAR, bind_method VARCHAR, evidence_id UBIGINT, directed BOOLEAN, change_kind STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, renamed_from STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, file STRUCT(path VARCHAR, "encoding" VARCHAR, bytes VARCHAR), symbol STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, "commit" VARCHAR))))[], spans STRUCT(span_id UBIGINT, file_id UBIGINT, start_byte UINTEGER, end_byte UINTEGER, start_line UINTEGER, end_line UINTEGER)[], macro_invocations STRUCT(site_id VARCHAR, file_path VARCHAR, source_oid VARCHAR, caller_stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, enclosing STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR), raw_macro_path VARCHAR, normalized_macro_path VARCHAR, byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[], attributes STRUCT(raw_text VARCHAR, "owner" STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR), byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[])[], test_context VARCHAR, debug_assertions_candidate BOOLEAN, execution_phase VARCHAR, resolution STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, definition STRUCT(file_path VARCHAR, source_oid VARCHAR, byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[])), sink_family_candidate VARCHAR)[], macro_scopes STRUCT("scope" STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR), file_path VARCHAR, source_oid VARCHAR, byte_range UBIGINT[], line_range UBIGINT[])[])

receipts.name: loaded_extension
receipts.sql: SELECT extension_name,loaded,extension_version FROM duckdb_extensions() WHERE extension_name='spur_graph'

receipts.name: control_calls
receipts.sql:
WITH nodes AS (SELECT unnest(value.nodes) AS n FROM control),
edges AS (SELECT unnest(value.edges) AS e FROM control)
SELECT src.n.label AS caller, e.e.target_label, e.e.target_node_id, dst.n.label AS target_name,
owner.n.label AS target_owner, e.e.scope_text, e.e.receiver_text, e.e.bind_method, e.e.confidence
FROM edges e LEFT JOIN nodes src ON src.n.node_id=e.e.source_node_id
LEFT JOIN nodes dst ON dst.n.node_id=e.e.target_node_id
LEFT JOIN edges parent ON parent.e.target_node_id=dst.n.node_id AND parent.e.relation='contains'
LEFT JOIN nodes owner ON owner.n.node_id=parent.e.source_node_id
WHERE e.e.relation='calls' AND src.n.label IN ('observed_macro','observed_helper','observed_drop','observed_local_macro','observed_mixed_macro')
ORDER BY caller,e.e.target_label,e.e.scope_text NULLS FIRST

receipts.name: selection
receipts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS files,(SELECT count(*) FROM frozen.main.edges e JOIN frozen.main.inventory i ON i.path=e.logical_path WHERE i.suffix='.rs' AND e.relation='calls' AND e.bind_method='macro_body_singleton' AND e.target_label='new') AS original_macro_constructor_edges FROM selected_paths

receipts.name: per_file_parity
receipts.sql:
SELECT f.logical_path,
f.value.nodes IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.value.nodes AS nodes_same,
f.value.spans IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.value.spans AS spans_same,
f.value.macro_invocations IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.value.macro_invocations AS invocations_same,
f.value.macro_scopes IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.value.macro_scopes AS scopes_same,
f.value.edges IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.value.edges AS edges_same,
len(f.value.edges) AS new_edges,len(old.value.edges) AS old_edges
FROM fresh f JOIN frozen.main.facts old USING(logical_path) ORDER BY f.logical_path

receipts.name: selected_call_counts
receipts.sql:
WITH old_edges AS (
SELECT e.* FROM frozen.main.edges e JOIN selected_paths p USING(logical_path)),
new_edges AS (SELECT f.logical_path,unnest(f.value.edges) AS e FROM fresh f)
SELECT 'baseline' AS version,count(*) AS calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE target_node_id IS NOT NULL) AS local_targets
FROM old_edges WHERE relation='calls'
UNION ALL SELECT 'candidate',count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.target_node_id IS NOT NULL) FROM new_edges WHERE e.relation='calls'

receipts.name: real_constructor_control
receipts.sql:
WITH f AS (
SELECT value FROM fresh WHERE logical_path='crates/spur-acp/src/capability_evidence.rs'),
nodes AS (SELECT unnest(value.nodes) AS n FROM f),edges AS (SELECT unnest(value.edges) AS e FROM f)
SELECT src.n.label AS caller,e.e.target_label,e.e.target_node_id,dst.n.label AS target_name,
owner.n.label AS target_owner,e.e.scope_text,e.e.bind_method
FROM edges e JOIN nodes src ON src.n.node_id=e.e.source_node_id
LEFT JOIN nodes dst ON dst.n.node_id=e.e.target_node_id
LEFT JOIN edges parent ON parent.e.target_node_id=dst.n.node_id AND parent.e.relation='contains'
LEFT JOIN nodes owner ON owner.n.node_id=parent.e.source_node_id
WHERE e.e.relation='calls' AND src.n.label='rejected_evidence_demotes_while_inconclusive_evidence_preserves_prior_routes'
AND regexp_extract(e.e.target_label,'([^:]+)$',1)='new' ORDER BY e.e.scope_text NULLS FIRST

limits: Selected files plus controlled fixtures; no full-corpus precision, recall or performance claim.
